problem: [VIS] taps clumped in one vertical bar per tile at x~2600 / x~8700 plus an arc at the tile east/west face; tile corners have only declared (purple) taps

problem: [VIS] very dense tap blobs at (2100-2700,12500) and (8500-9000,12400-13300), and purple declared-tap clusters on the band north edge at x~4600-5000 and ~6600-6800,y~13750
